name: bookmark
title: Bookmark
description: A ribbon bookmark you can press. Unpressed, a dashed pencil ghost of a ribbon marks the place; pressed, the woven, edge-stitched cloth ribbon hangs there in its color and casts a short shadow. It is a Toggle underneath, so `aria-pressed`, Space and Enter come for free. `BookmarkRibbon` is the same ribbon as a page marker with no behavior.

a11y: Bookmark is a real toggle button: it announces "pressed" or "not pressed", it is reached by Tab and pressed with Space or Enter. Give it a name that says what it saves ("Save this article"); the name does not change with the state, `aria-pressed` does.

The ribbon, its stitching and its ghost are aria-hidden decoration, so the state is never carried by color alone: `aria-pressed` and the ghost-versus-ribbon shape (dashed outline versus a filled tail) both tell it. Focus shows the standard focus ring around the box.

The hit area is 44 x 60 px with its extension (24 px minimum). Windows high contrast replaces the drawing with a button outline, and a pressed bookmark fills with the system highlight color so the state is still visible; `aria-pressed` follows either way.
meta.usage:
import { Bookmark, BookmarkRibbon } from "@/components/ui/bookmark"

<Card class="relative">
  <Bookmark class="absolute -top-1 end-6" defaultPressed onPressedChange={save}>
    Save this article
  </Bookmark>
  …
</Card>

<Paper class="relative"><BookmarkRibbon tone="grape" class="absolute -top-1 end-8" /></Paper>
